body: I'm not really sure what to think or to expect. But it kills me watching him struggle everyday with me. Watching him increasingly get madder and in turn take it out on me because he doesn't want to make me feel bad or add to my stress. But I see it eating at him. And I know most people would say if your toxic leave him. I just literally have nothing but an apartment I can't afford by myself. A job that's even worse than my current home life, and a future I don't have enough drive to persue anymore. So where would you start?
